observations: Photo 0: A PlayStation console in 'slim' body style (single thin horizontal line, no extra vents of the Pro) sitting on a box, with 'PS4' logo visible on top edge.
Photo 0: Two DualShock-style wireless controllers (black) resting on top of the console, standard PS4 controller layout with touchpad and light bar.
Photo 0: An LG monitor/TV is visible behind, console is on a cardboard box, no close-up of ports, serial number, or power brick.

Photo 1 and 2: Screenshots of a PS4 'Library' screen listing game tiles: Call of Duty Modern Warfare III, EA Sports FC 27, Far Cry, God of War Ragnarok, Grand Theft Auto V, Little Nightmares II, Mortal Kombat 11, Resident Evil Village, Rise of the Tomb Raider, The Last of Us Part II, The Playroom, The Witcher 3, Ghost Recon Wildlands, Uncharted 4, Watch Dogs 2.
Watermark 'GAMECUBE COMPUTERS' overlaid on all photos, suggesting a reseller/shop account rather than an individual owner.
No photo shows the console powered on in person, no close-up of rear ports, no photo of box/invoice, no video of gameplay.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim console with 2 wireless controllers

claims.evidence: No photo shows firmware/jailbreak screen, system software version, or any indication of modification; claim rests on seller's words only.

Photos 1 and 2 show a library list with roughly 14-15 tiles visible, but some tiles may be placeholders/demos (e.g. The Playroom) and not all are confirmed fully installed or playable; count not independently verifiable.

claims.claim: Games: FC 27, GTA V, COD MW3, God of War Ragnarok, Mortal Kombat 11
claims.evidence: Visible as named tiles in photo 1 and photo 2 library screenshots.
Photo 0 shows two controllers physically present on the console.

risks.risk: Jailbroken/'hacked' consoles often have unstable firmware, may be permanently banned from PSN, and can fail after a system update or control board fault.
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on, navigating the menu, and launching one of the listed games live.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / high-risk modified unit

risks.risk: Games shown in library may be digital licenses tied to an account that will not transfer, or may not actually be installed (just icons).
risks.proof: Screenshot of 'Storage' settings showing installed game sizes, or a video showing a game launching from the disc-free library.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, games not guaranteed to transfer

risks.risk: Controller battery health and analog stick drift cannot be judged from a static photo.
risks.proof: A short video showing both controllers connecting wirelessly and moving analog sticks on screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers of unknown/worn condition

risks.risk: No view of rear ports, power brick, or HDMI cable; missing accessories lower resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the console and the included power/HDMI cables.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, accessories assumed missing

risks.risk: Storage drive capacity and health (HDD/SSD) unknown, affects how many games can actually fit and run.
risks.proof: Screenshot of System > Storage showing total and free capacity.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base/stock storage assumption (500GB) with no verified health

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading one of the listed games to confirm it works and is truly playable, not just icons.
Screenshot of System Storage settings showing installed games and free space.
Photo of the rear ports and included cables/power brick.
Short clip of both controllers connecting and sticks moving on-screen to confirm no drift.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 Slim console with two controllers and a visible game library, but the 'hacked' status, game installation state, and controller/console functional health are all unverified from photos alone, so it must be priced at the worst-case condition of an unproven, modified unit until video/screenshot proof is provided.
